stations.title: Sign-up page
stations.text: Shows the workshops, but takes no bookings.

captions: Dilys found fourteen names on the paper sheet for a morning with twelve places.
The page shows the workshops, but it takes no bookings and cannot count places.
You add a bookings table, a way to book, and places left counted by the database.
Bronagh books the family morning on the page, and its places left go down.
Bookings live beside the workshops, and every workshop shows what it has left.
